name: Indus Towers Ltd
title: Indus Towers Ltd - 534816 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Indus Towers' Q4 FY26 supply-side picture is steady, not cyclical: 4,892 macro towers and 6,192 co-locations added, tenancy stable at 1.62, but EBITDA margin slipped to 55.1% and management pays out full FY26 FCF.

capex.quote: 70% of the capex that we spend is growth oriented, which basically leads to growth in our revenue and bottom line. And just about 25% is basically something that goes towards replacement, maintenance and so on.

triggers.label: Full-year FCF fully distributed as dividend
triggers.quote: the Board decided to distribute the full cash generation of this year as a dividend, which is what is reflected in the INR 14

triggers.label: Second tenant onboarding could lift tenancy
triggers.quote: as the second customer comes on board, we might actually see some improvement also
triggers.highlight: we might actually see some improvement

triggers.label: Tower supply tight from LPG and war disruption
triggers.quote: there is a little bit of a tightness in the market in terms of tower supplies because that is dependent on LPG availability
triggers.highlight: tightness in the market in terms of tower supplies

triggers.label: Reported EBITDA margin 55.1%, down 1.8pp YoY
triggers.quote: The EBITDA margin was lower by 1.8 percentage points year-on-year and 0.2 percentage points quarter -on-quarter at 55.1% for Q4 FY26.

triggers.label: Major customer contract expiries, tenancies not renewed
triggers.quote: one of your major customer contract has expired and from what we understand that customer has not renewed the contract
triggers.highlight: customer has not renewed the contract

guidance.quote: from a full year perspective, I think we are pretty much in line with our expectation of 55% plus sort of an EBITDA level

red_flags.label: Major customer non-renewals and churn
red_flags.quote: one of your major customer contract has expired and from what we understand that customer has not renewed the contract

red_flags.label: Dividend pays out all FY26 FCF with Africa capex ahead
red_flags.quote: the Board decided to distribute the full cash generation of this year as a dividend

evasions.quote: I would not give you an outlook in that format because, see, the last few years were determined by deploying towers for one major customer.
honestly speaking, I don't think the Board compartmentalized the cash flows in that category.
there are certain tenancies that have expired which are still operating and some churn has happened, which we report.
